messages.tip.action_button: Runs this action using the current data and parameter values.
messages.tip.angle: Minimum angular separation, in degrees, between accepted density maxima. Larger values keep fewer, more widely separated główny poles; smaller values may retain nearby peaks from the same orientation rodzina.
messages.tip.bins: Sets the KDE density-grid level as 2^N cells per axis. Higher values reveal finer density detail but require more memory and computation. Use the lowest value that resolves stable density maxima.
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns each point to the closest reviewed główny pole within the JS cone threshold and writes the JS pole skalarne. The reviewed pole table, not the original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: Select the number of rotation degrees of freedom. Use 2 for the original two-angle rotation model or 3 for the intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler rotation used by the three-degree-of-freedom model.
messages.tip.colour.objective: Select the objective function minimised during optimisation. It controls how the rotated pole orientations are penalised or distributed in the colour reference system.
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage of valid point normalne used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation time; 100% uses all valid normalne.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: Maksimum number of differential-evolution generations. Higher values allow a more extensive search but increase computation time.
messages.tip.colour.population: Population multiplier used by differential evolution. Larger values evaluate more candidate rotations per generation, increasing search effort and computation time.
messages.tip.colour.seed: Optional integer random seed. Enter a value to make the sampling and optimisation reproducible; leave blank to use a new random seed.
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare chmura punktów coloured using the selected colour space and the selected pole space. The original chmura punktów is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: Displays the relative pole-density distribution obtained with the optimised rotation. It does not run the optimisation again.
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays the point-normalna poles after applying the optimised rotation, using the selected stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When fasety are created, also creates one separate chmura punktów for each końcowy klaster. Disable this for very large datasets if the additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within each positive JS rodzina, estimates a rodzina-specific eps, removes components smaller than ppcluster, fits płaszczyzna equations, and writes cl, A, B, C, D and sigma using the original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts the normalna-colour optimisation with the parameters entered above and determines the rotation angles that minimise the selected objective function.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: Minimum number of points inside the DBSCAN neighbourhood, including the point itself, required for a core point. The MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this value requires denser neighbourhoods and may classify more points as noise.
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates the KDE pole-density surface and extracts automatic główny poles. Review and, if necessary, edit the resulting pole table before assigning JS rodziny.
messages.tip.editable_param: Editable parameter. Enter a numeric value where appropriate; the associated label indicates the units and the parameter effect.
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex planar mesh for each valid końcowy klaster using its stored global point indices and fitted płaszczyzna. Clustering must be completed first.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one chmura punktów for each positive JS rodzina. Each chmura punktów contains that rodzina’s points and retains the JS, cl and płaszczyzna pola skalarne.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point normalne coloured by their current JS value and overlays the reviewed główny poles. This is available only when JS corresponds to the current reviewed pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When selected, each klaster in a JS rodzina uses the reviewed rodzina-pole normalna and derives only D from the klaster centroid. When cleared, each klaster normalna is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: Maksimum angular difference, in degrees, between a point normalna and a reviewed główny pole. The closest pole inside this cone defines JS; points outside all cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used to estimate eps separately for each JS rodzina. The MATLAB method uses K=4 and queries K+1 neighbours because the first result is the point itself. Larger K represents a broader local spacing scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier in eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. The MATLAB method uses 2. Larger values increase eps and tend to join components across wider gaps; smaller values tend to split klastry.
messages.tip.labels: Shows cardinal directions, angular guides and stereonet annotations. These guides are visual only and do not affect the calculations.
messages.tip.maxpoles: Maksimum number of automatic główny poles retained from the density surface. It limits the candidate JS rodziny; the reviewed pole table remains authoritative and can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold based on |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger values merge more same-rodzina klastry into a common płaszczyzna; smaller values preserve more separate płaszczyzny. Set 0 to disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: Minimum component size after DBSCAN, corresponding to MATLAB ppcluster. Components with fewer points are rejected and assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots all valid point normalne as poles on the selected stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step and does not modify the chmura punktów.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new główny pole from the Kierunek upadu and Upad values. The table and density plot update immediately; rodzina IDs are renumbered and existing JS and klaster results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies the Kierunek upadu and Upad values to the selected główny pole. The reviewed table becomes the source of truth, so JS classification and clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes the selected główny pole, renumbers the remaining rodziny and refreshes the plot. Existing JS and klaster results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves the selected pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes rodzina IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes the rodzina order. Because rodzina IDs follow table order, changing the order requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative reviewed list of główny poles. JS classification, rodzina plots, Fisher K and subsequent clustering use this exact order and orientation. Editing or reordering the table invalidates existing JS and klaster results.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves the selected pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes rodzina IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, density and automatic peak detection use the original normalne or normalne transformed by the optimised rotation. Stored główny-pole orientations always remain in the original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects the stereographic projection used for plots. Równokątna preserves angular relationships; equal-area preserves area. This setting changes only the visual projection, not the original point normalne or pola skalarne.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes the selected CloudCompare entity and checks which workflow actions and Narzędzia commands have the data required to run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only with Losowy klaster ordering. The same seed reproduces the numbering; leave blank to generate a new random order for each run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays the last computed density and current główny poles without recalculating the KDE or detecting peaks.
messages.tip.sort: Controls końcowy cl numbering within each JS rodzina. Size orders the largest klastry first, D follows their spatial position along the fitted normalna, and Losowy shuffles the order. IDs restart at 1 for each rodzina.
messages.tip.style: Chooses line contours or filled contours for the density plot. This changes visualisation only; density values and detected poles are not recalculated.

messages.about.body:
Authors:
  Adrián Riquelme Guill
  Roberto Tomás Jover
  Antonio Abellán Fernández
  University of Alicante

Scientific references:
  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
  A new approach for semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
  from 3D point clouds. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
  Discontinuity spacing analysis in rock masses using 3D point clouds.
  Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
  Automatic mapping of discontinuity persistence on rock masses using
  3D point clouds. Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
  https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
  Orientation-based colour mapping and spherical density analysis for
  rock discontinuity detection in 3D point clouds of roadcut slopes.
  Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

  Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
  Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
  familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
  evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University of
  Alicante.
  https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based on:
  Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation of the Discontinuity Set
  Extractor (DSE), Department of Civil Engineering, University of
  Alicante, Spain.

Libraries and algorithms:
  - NumPy: numerical arrays and vector operations.
  - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
    connected components and convex-hull geometry.
  - Matplotlib: stereonet, density and analysis plotting.
  - colorcet: scientific and perceptually useful colour maps used by
    the klaster visualisation.
  - Pillow: icon loading, resizing and GUI icon normalisation.
  - CloudCompare / pycc: point-chmura punktów, normalna and scalar-field access.
  - Tkinter / ttk: graphical user interface.
  - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D normalna/sphere visualisation.

  Algorithms and methods:
  - DSE główny-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, based on
    the Botev et al. kernel-density approach.
  - Differential Evolution for normalna-colour rotation optimisation.
  - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) for spatial clustering of discontinuity
    rodziny.
  - Fisher directional statistics for mean-pole concentration and
    confidence intervals.
  - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches and Qhull convex-hull geometry
    through SciPy.

Acknowledgments:
  CloudCompare development team and the researchers whose methods
  underpin the DSE workflow.
